title: Ackman Edit DNA
description: Reverse-engineered editing DNA of the viral Bill Ackman biographical reel by @metromedia.house. Fast-paced retention hook, kinetic poster typography, face match cutting, and layered granular sound design.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Edit Flash Open
ingredients.description: DRAFT / not the version you're before it ran in this original post. Use case: The first seconds, viral hook opening cut with instantaneous white strobe flash and bass impact.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Poster Title Punch
ingredients.description: DRAFT / not the version you're before it ran in this original post. Use case: text that seals the hook with heavy tracked kinetic text and soft yellow/cyan bloom.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Screen Name Reveal
ingredients.description: DRAFT / not the version you're before it ran in this original post. The context the person is talking about with minimalist credentialing typography.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Difference Pull Back
ingredients.description: DRAFT / not the version you're before it ran in this original post. The math about the person pulling back to their body of work on a stark backdrop.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Face Match Cut
ingredients.description: DRAFT / not the version you're before it ran in this original post. The person in person or replica, over their own history head rolling.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Grid Cut List
ingredients.description: Rapid 3x3 rhythmic contact sheet flash cut depicting evidence, achievements, and archival press snippets.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Quantity Or Quality
ingredients.description: Dueling typography comparison layout split down the middle with directional motion blur and high-pass swoosh.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Flip Stack And Notes
ingredients.description: Tactile card stack drop with physics bounce and smooth drop shadows highlighting key take-aways.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Viewfinder REC
ingredients.description: Authentic camera HUD overlay with blinking red recording dot, crosshairs, shutter clicks, and ISO indicators.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Counter Rate
ingredients.description: Digital metric odometer rolling up from zero to viral numbers with mechanical tally clicks.

ingredients.title: Ackman DNA: Granular Sound Design
ingredients.description: ElevenLabs SFX and multi-track REAPER automation with sidechain speech ducking, tactile risers, and impact drops.
